member.name: T:OblivionMp.Sdk.Serverside.Mod
member.summary: Derives from the SDK's own base rather than the relay's, which is what puts the shape SDK in place on this side: every replicated shape registered with the relay, the entity API a handle reads through, native init and delete for mod components, and every [Service] any loaded mod declared.
member.remarks: One mod in the host does this and it covers all of them: the registries it reads are filled from every loaded assembly before the first mod is built, and the container is shared.
